mentions.name: Quato
mentions.description: A B2B SaaS platform that hosts 3D scans of data centers and large industrial plants as a Google Street View-style tour. Users can draw 3D linework to trace paths of pipes and conduits, add markdown and HTML-linked notes at useful places in the 3D space, and use an 'xray' view floorplan add-on to navigate large spaces. It includes a web uploader that can preview and import .e57 panoramas directly in the browser, optionally skipping the points. Currently in use by a telco in the Americas.
